tools.name: create_or_update_task

task_id.description: Known Task identity (with or without a Project) to patch; omit to create.

description.description: Trimmed non-empty Task content; required for create.

status.description: Explicit business status patch; forbidden during create.

context_files.description: Absolute local file paths on this node to copy into the Project Task's saved context (appended on patch; never removes). Same file types and 25 MiB limit as the app.
